close_reason: Fixed in 490df257b: native/codegen ABI now handles mixed publication lanes and boxed callable fast-path fallback.
description: While reducing fz-bin.17, a local make/3 returning {:ok, n, fn -> ...} and then calling the closure after dbg(n) exposed a separate native direct-call fast-path bug. After entry-capture encoding correctly treats the closure as boxed/published, the direct closure call still selects the local target and passes structural capture lanes plus call args, producing a verifier mismatch such as main__e0__resume_2 got 6 args for a target signature expecting 3. Range enumerable no longer depends on this path because the protocol slicer uses the published callable boundary, but the direct fast path should skip boxed/published callable values or rematerialize through the settled boundary before direct target invocation.

comments.text: fz-bin.17 full-suite verification exposed this as a blocking prerequisite, not a follow-up. After tuple-return callable publication is enabled, captured-closure handoff fixtures still fail native lowering: /tmp/materialized_transport_handoff_refs.fz reports native attempted to encode callable shape ShapeId(13) for value Some(ValueId(1)) from Runtime(Var(0)) in Continuation { owner: FnId(4), index: 1 }. Transport publications exist for Value/CallArg/ExecutableInput positions, including apply1's callable input and pair/escape value positions, but native return/continuation lowering can still consume an ExecutableReturn or continuation ABI that lacks the matching publication and then attempts structural callable encoding from a boxed runtime var. This must be resolved before fz-bin.17 can be committed with cargo test --lib green.

Further fz-bin.18 reduction on materialized_transport_handoff_refs.fz shows pair/escape publications are present broadly, including Value, CallArg, ExecutableInput, pair ResumePayload, pair ExecutableReturn, escape ExecutableReturn, and ReturnPayload positions. The failing native body is Continuation { owner: FnId(4), index: 1 }, encoding callable shape ShapeId(13) for value Some(ValueId(1)) from Runtime(Var(0)). A recursive mixed tuple ABI experiment fixed neither the handoff fixture nor range_enumerable; range then panicked in native_codegen/terminator.rs at callee_param_reprs indexing, proving the ABI and emitted arg lanes diverged. The correct fix needs to align transport publication positions, native continuation/return ABI construction, and direct callable argument lowering atomically.

Resolved native/codegen side of the blocker: native ABI construction now encodes/decodes publication-aware positions recursively instead of treating any publication as publication-only, return/resume/capture signatures use mixed raw/publication lane reprs, direct closure fast path declines boxed/published callable args and mismatched arity, closure target codegen consumes authoritative boundary ABI, and decoded multi-surface published closures no longer require one stored boundary. Broader polymorphic indirect-closure dispatch is tracked separately as fz-x2n; current direct-target polymorphic fixtures are green.

title: Direct fast path miscalls boxed tuple-returned closure after resume
